campaign_name: AT-OPT-02 Unresolved Retreat Routing and Verification Budget Enforcement
purpose: Stop a simple unresolved retreat from entering primary narration when physical adjudication is off, and make the F3 HTTP verification profile enforce a 3000-token total before provider dispatch.
executive_summary: Verdict A/PASS. Failure class: implementation defect. With physical adjudication off, I step back from the notice board now returns the existing unsupported sentence, does not enter call_gpt, and is an operational refusal. Turn, position, and last_publication stay unchanged. With physical adjudication on, the existing retreat commit still sets position kind back. Unrelated unresolved speech, scene questions, and Gate Guard host speech keep their owners. The F3 HTTP script now calls apply_verification_budget before importing the app. A missing total is 3000. Total 200000 without a recorded override is rejected. An oversized estimate is refused before the fake provider runs. The bytes/3 estimate does not prove every admitted actual total stays under 3000. The historical 23377-token call was not repeated. Live provider calls: 0. New tests 20/20. Adjacent tests 118/118. Frozen holdout cases 28/28. Protected files 150/150. Do not start AT-OPT-03.

production: game/physical_adjudication.py recognizes a clear simple retreat and returns the existing unsupported sentence only when physical adjudication is disabled.
game/api.py returns that refusal before the turn increment and blocks primary narration at the existing skip fall-through.
game/publication_contract.py records the retreat refusal and a provider-budget refusal as operational refusals, so they do not become completed gameplay.
game/verification_budget.py installs the verification ceiling into the existing admission environment variables.
artifacts/pr_play_79df3/http_acceptance.py calls that profile instead of writing a 200000 total.

tooling: artifacts/at_opt_02/rerun_holdout.py reruns the frozen holdout without writing the historical results file.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Do not start AT-OPT-03 from this handoff.
Do not treat the 3000 verification total as a production opening cap. Recorded openings are about 25294 input tokens.
Do not read the historical 23377-token F3 call as a saving measured in this cycle.

campaign_specific: Compounds, step-back-to, questions, quotations, and third-person step-back wording still use their previous route when physical adjudication is off.
The pre-dispatch estimate can disagree with actual provider usage. A fitting estimate is not proof the actual total stays under 3000.
The HTTP script's continuation_advances check still describes the pre-correction publication. The script was not re-run.
pre_existing: Primary narration payloads remain opening-scale when a turn is still eligible for that route.
The classification harness still passes explicit 100000/200000 ceilings when a test asks for them.
HEAD does not uniquely identify the executable source because the worktree was already dirty.

missing_concepts: A live measurement of the token delta for this retreat, which this cycle deliberately did not take.
Pre-dispatch logging of the input estimate, which was already noted in AT-OPT-01 and was not added here.
does_not_prove: It does not prove a newly measured token saving against the historical 23377-token request.
It does not prove that every admitted provider request stays under 3000 actual tokens.
It does not prove the retreat pattern covers every physical sentence.
It does not prove a Gameplay Benchmark result. No benchmark was run.
The new routing tests were authored with the fix. They are not independent held-out evidence. The frozen 28-case holdout does not include this retreat sentence.
recommended_next_step: Stop. Do not start AT-OPT-03. Do not open PR-PLAY-80. Do not put the 3000 verification total on production openings.
self_contained_review_test: The bundle contains the five AT-OPT-02 reports, the routing and regression JSON, the redirected holdout result, and the protected-file rehash. No live play was produced.
